name: glancecard
title: Glancecard
description: View any GitHub profile or repository as a glancecard in 25 looks, save the SVG, set up README cards, and ask AI for GitHub stats.
author: Undolog

commands.name: profile-card
commands.title: Profile Card
commands.subtitle: Glancecard
commands.description: A GitHub profile's card in every look: yours, or anyone's by login

commands.name: repository-card
commands.title: Repository Card
commands.subtitle: Glancecard
commands.description: A public repository's card in every look: yours, or any repository on GitHub

commands.name: set-up-glancecard
commands.title: Set up Glancecard
commands.subtitle: Glancecard
commands.description: Where glancecard stands on your GitHub, and the workflow, README embeds and agent prompt that set it up or change it

preferences.name: personalAccessToken
preferences.title: Personal Access Token
preferences.description: Optional. Leave empty to sign in with GitHub; a token needs no scope to read public data.

preferences.name: timeZone
preferences.title: Time Zone
preferences.description: IANA time zone the calendar and the weekly rhythm are read in, such as Europe/Rome. Empty: this Mac's.

tools.name: get-profile-stats
tools.title: Get Profile Stats
tools.description: Get the numbers on a GitHub profile's glancecard: followers, stars across public repositories and how many came in the last 30 days and the last year, contributions and commits in the last year, pull requests, issues, the most starred repositories and languages. Leave the login empty for the signed-in user.

tools.name: get-repository-stats
tools.title: Get Repository Stats
tools.description: Get the numbers on a public GitHub repository's glancecard: stars and how many came in the last 30 days and the last year, commits in the last 30 days and the last year, streaks, busiest weekday and hour, languages, releases and downloads, contributors, issues and pull requests, latest commits.

ai.instructions:
- The numbers are glancecard's, read from GitHub's public data; `readAt` says when. Contributions follow GitHub's own calendar for the last year.
- starHistory counts the stars still given, by the day they were given; it can be a star or two short of the repository's total. Null means GitHub had no history to give.
- commitsLastYear counts the default branch only; when commitsLastYearIsCapped is true the repository has more than glancecard reads, so say "at least".
- These tools only read: to show a card, point to the Profile Card or Repository Card command; to put cards in a README, to Set up Glancecard.

evals.input: @glancecard how many stars did gfazioli/glancecard get in the last 30 days?

get-repository-stats.description: Your GitHub profile and repositories, at a glance

evals.input: @glancecard how many followers does octocat have, and which of their repositories has the most stars?
@glancecard what is the busiest weekday on gfazioli/glancecard?

get-repository-stats.description: Your GitHub profile and repositories, at a glance
